# Municipal Ordinance No. 10, Series of 2014

**An Ordinance Mandating the Creation and the Institutionalization of the Barangay Health Boards in Each of the 39 Barangays of the Municipality of Pitogo**

## Summary

Mandates the creation and institutionalization of [[Barangay Health Board]]s in each of the 39 barangays of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. Authored by Hon. [[Emilio R. Veloso]]. References Article XIII, Section 11 of the 1987 Constitution on the comprehensive health system, and [[Sec-17-RA7160]] on basic health services devolved to LGUs.

Absent: [[Carlos T. Gliane II]].

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1 — Legal Background:** Cites [[Sec-17-RA7160]] (basic health services devolved to LGUs) and Article XIII, Section 11 of the 1987 Constitution on comprehensive health system
- **Section 2 — Creation and Composition:**
  - Honorary Chairman: Municipal Mayor
  - Chairman: Elected by NGOs/POs/PS
- **Coverage:** All 39 barangays of Pitogo must establish and institutionalize their respective Barangay Health Boards
- **Purpose:** Strengthening community-level health governance and service delivery

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Paulino S. Sayat]] — Municipal Mayor / Honorary Chairman of Barangay Health Boards
- [[Dexter L. Sayat]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer
- [[Emilio R. Veloso]] — author of the ordinance
- [[Municipal Health Office]]

## Legal Basis

- [[Sec-16-RA7160]] — General welfare clause
- [[Sec-17-RA7160]] — Basic services and facilities (health services devolved to LGUs)
- [[Sec-447-RA7160]] — Powers, duties, functions of the Sangguniang Bayan
- 1987 Constitution, Article XIII, Section 11 — Comprehensive health system
